scenarios.name: Inspect ribbon appearance choices without changing the display mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software
a part has an active editable sketch in the MCAD Software
ribbon appearance is set to Normal
the user opens Ribbon Appearance from the Create panel title context menu
Text Off, Small, Compact, Large and Reset Ribbon are listed
the Ribbon Appearance submenu remains open
the user clicks in the viewport outside the menu
the ribbon remains in Normal appearance
the sketch remains active and unchanged
